head: 2d4f3869b4bffab3d4702a091d0fd632a5f27f0f
scope: ProofLedger loading, batch append, lookup policy and snapshot; ProofShadow changed-package capture, candidate selection, record ordering and report bar. This is not a complete review of every ProofShadow entrypoint or downstream enforcement consumer.
findings: Newest appended self-consistent exact fact is selected; failed or expired exact facts miss. Undeclared inputs and changed-package tripwire miss. Identity includes lane, command, input, profile and epoch.
Batch lookup shares one file load; batch append encodes rows and appends once, recovering an unterminated tail with a newline. No cross-process transaction or concurrency guarantee is inferred.
Shadow candidates exclude reused and early-stopped lanes and require command text. All lookups precede the batch of new shadow/fact rows. Missing lane input digests remain undeclared.
Changed-package capture includes committed and worktree paths; unavailable capture trips scoped lanes. Empty scopes rely on the input digest. This does not establish semantic input closure.
The default report bar counts distinct pre-push/local attempts and branches and hit-versus-failure disagreements. It does not require successful reuse hits or zero malformed rows.

tests.command: bun run --cwd packages/tooling/tool/cli test test/proof-ledger.test.ts test/proof-shadow.test.ts

remaining: The report readiness flag is not qualification, signed remote evidence, successful-hit coverage, or authorization to change Yeet proof ownership.
All 13 existing broad census obligations remain open. Production enforcement consumers, concurrency, semantic closure and signed sibling receipts remain separately required.
